title: REQ · A reload counter in the history effect powers Retry
summary: Retry re-runs the history effect through a reload counter
description: Context: no way to reload history after failure. Desired behavior: a reloadKey counter in the history effect deps; the error state shows a Retry button that increments it, and the effect alone sets status back to loading. Expected result: one click retries the load. Why: recoverable failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given status is error, When Retry is clicked, Then listMine is called a second time
Given the retry resolves, When the effect settles, Then status is ready and Retry is gone
Given status is not error, When rendered, Then no Retry button exists

in_scope: reloadKey state, effect dependency, Retry button
preserve: Single-writer rule: the button never sets history status directly

definition_of_done: Retry works via the reload counter
